meta.attribution: Stellarium sky culture 'modern_chinese'; authors: This skyculture was contributed by Stellarium user Sun Shuwei . Constellation art，Constellation lines based on Modern Skyculture for Stellarium. Asterism lines and traditional Chinese star names based on Chinese Traditional Skyculture for Stellarium (Text and data: CC BY-SA 4.0). Converted to HIP line segments only; no artwork or description images were copied.
meta.conversion_scope: Only constellations[].lines, id and common_name (plus optional common_names star labels) are converted; illustrations, artwork and description text are not copied.
meta.names_scope: Explicit common_names labels take precedence; stars without an explicit label inherit the constellation/asterism name they belong to.
